narrative.overview: Use familiar macOS controls, quiet neutral surfaces, and a clear hierarchy of project, service, and supporting details. Keep the established sidebar, toolbar, and Docker footer. This document covers the existing project detail, service graph cards, and menu bar popover; it does not prescribe new product surfaces.

Compact summaries with supporting details behind disclosures.

rules.name: The Adaptive Neutral Rule
rules.body: Preserve native semantic colors across light and dark appearances; do not substitute a fixed gray palette or colored technology logos.

dos: Do use native semantic colors and typography.
Do preserve the sidebar, footer, and toolbar structure.
Do keep status and immediate actions visible while disclosing supporting details.
Do keep technology icons monochrome and use the visualize menu-bar symbol fallback.
donts: Don't add persistent widget row selection.
Don't replace native components with web-style approximations or decorative brand colors.
Don't claim a visual or interaction pass from source review alone.
